method: Figure series: elements move along a fixed cycle
steps: Five elements occupy positions TL, TR, centre, BL, BR
Each element moves every step along TL->BL->BR->TR->centre->TL
Circle: TL,BL,BR,TR -> centre; triangle: BL,BR,TR,C -> TL; square: BR,TR,C,TL -> BL; down arrow: TR,C,TL,BL -> BR; up arrow: C,TL,BL,BR -> TR
Figure 5: TL triangle, TR up arrow, centre circle, BL square, BR down arrow = option B
check_code:
cyc=['TL','BL','BR','TR','C']
nxt=lambda p:cyc[(cyc.index(p)+1)%5]
figs=[{'circle':'TL','down':'TR','up':'C','tri':'BL','sq':'BR'},
      {'up':'TL','sq':'TR','down':'C','circle':'BL','tri':'BR'},
      {'down':'TL','tri':'TR','sq':'C','up':'BL','circle':'BR'},
      {'sq':'TL','circle':'TR','tri':'C','down':'BL','up':'BR'}]
for a,b in zip(figs,figs[1:]):
    assert all(nxt(a[k])==b[k] for k in a)
f5={k:nxt(v) for k,v in figs[-1].items()}
opts={'A':{'circle':'TL','up':'TR','sq':'C','tri':'BL','down':'BR'},
      'B':{'tri':'TL','up':'TR','circle':'C','sq':'BL','down':'BR'},
      'C':{'sq':'TL','down':'TR','circle':'C','tri':'BL','up':'BR'},
      'D':{'sq':'TL','up':'TR','tri':'C','circle':'BL','down':'BR'}}
assert f5==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert f5!=opts[k]

method: Figure series: letters move along a fixed cycle
steps: Five letters at TL, TR, centre, BL, BR
Each letter moves each step along TL->TR->BR->BL->centre->TL
Fig4: C at TL, D at TR, B centre, A at BL, E at BR
Fig5: B at TL, C at TR, A centre, E at BL, D at BR = option B
check_code:
cyc=['TL','TR','BR','BL','C']
nxt=lambda p:cyc[(cyc.index(p)+1)%5]
figs=[{'A':'TL','B':'TR','E':'C','D':'BL','C':'BR'},
      {'E':'TL','A':'TR','D':'C','C':'BL','B':'BR'},
      {'D':'TL','E':'TR','C':'C','B':'BL','A':'BR'},
      {'C':'TL','D':'TR','B':'C','A':'BL','E':'BR'}]
for a,b in zip(figs,figs[1:]):
    assert all(nxt(a[k])==b[k] for k in a)
f5={k:nxt(v) for k,v in figs[-1].items()}
opts={'A':{'D':'TL','B':'TR','A':'C','C':'BL','E':'BR'},
      'B':{'B':'TL','C':'TR','A':'C','E':'BL','D':'BR'},
      'C':{'D':'TL','B':'TR','A':'C','C':'BL','E':'BR','mirrored':True},
      'D':{'E':'TL','C':'TR','B':'C','A':'BL','D':'BR'}}
assert f5==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert f5!=opts[k]
